title: Evaluating Cultural Knowledge Processing in Large Language Models: A Cognitive Benchmarking Framework Integrating Retrieval-Augmented Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on a custom multiple-choice benchmark (the Hakka Cultural Benchmark) structured around Bloom's Taxonomy, comparing closed-book models to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models to assess factual correctness, cultural alignment, and the presence of culturally inaccurate hallucinations regarding a minority culture.
